biggest_catch: The named program does not exist anymore — Meta killed the Reels Play bonus in March 2023 with no replacement open to the public; today's replacement (unified Content Monetization / performance bonuses) is invite-only with no published payout amounts, so there is no reliable path for a regular person to earn from it.
catches: Meta's Reels Play bonus program was discontinued in March 2023 — the company stopped offering any new or renewed Reels Play deals on Facebook and Instagram; only existing commitments were honored for 30 days.
The 'up to $35,000/month' figures quoted for the old program were invite-only deals with undisclosed benchmarks; even at its peak you could not sign up for it — you had to be invited.

The current successor is Meta's unified Content Monetization Program (instream ads, ads on Reels, performance bonuses, Stars, subscriptions) — invite-only, payouts calculated by an undisclosed performance algorithm, with no public payout amounts or eligibility terms on official Meta pages.

The newer 'Creator Fast Track' (March 2026) is Facebook-only, invitation-based, and requires an already-large following elsewhere (100K+ followers on Instagram/TikTok/YouTube) — it is not an Instagram Reels bonus a regular person can join.
Because no current program publishes a concrete payout with exact eligibility and timing, this cannot pass the concrete-payout checklist.

c1.evidence: Meta Platforms, Inc. — real company, official domain creators.facebook.com / about.meta.com.

c2.evidence: No current official terms page exists for an 'Instagram Reels Bonus' — the Reels Play bonus was discontinued by Meta in March 2023 per the Meta spokesperson statement reported by The Verge/Business Insider.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee involved in the historical program or the current unified monetization tools; failure is not on fees.

c4.evidence: No concrete payout is stated in current official terms — the old Reels Play deals had invite-only variable payouts (up to $35,000/month at launch), and the current unified program publishes no payout amounts at all.

eligibility: None — the Reels Play bonus program is discontinued and no public sign-up exists. The legacy program was invite-only (US creators on Instagram and Facebook creators); the current unified Content Monetization Program is invite-only with Meta-defined criteria.
